data.exact_reserve_text: The gross prior year development for 2016 and 2015 underwriting years, calculated from the claims development table on page 16, shows a release of GBP 36.501 million. The calendar year has been benign with no major loss activity to date. The 2018 year of account has run very favourably to date with Property Gross Earned Loss ratio at 27% and, for all other classes, loss reserve assumptions have been held at planned levels following consideration of the experience in the year.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant gross prior year reserve release of GBP 36.501 million, primarily driven by favorable claims development on the 2016 and 2015 underwriting years. The calendar year was described as benign with no major loss activity, and loss reserve assumptions were held at planned levels, contributing to the overall positive development.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year development figure is calculated from the claims development table as no explicit gross figure was stated in narrative. Percentages for gross premium mix are calculated based on the total gross written premium.
